claims.text: The tweets were filtered using names of the target clubs and annotated for stance as Favor or Against.
A total of 700 tweets were annotated, with an equal number of tweets for each stance category for two football clubs.
The annotated dataset includes tweet IDs, stance targets, and stance classifications in a publicly available CSV format.
